reading.prompt: Why did the project begin?
reading.passage: At Stonebridge Academy, students recently created a new community garden. The idea began after Ruby noticed that many classmates wanted a practical project they could manage themselves. Instead of asking the school to buy everything, the group borrowed equipment from the museum and collected reusable materials from families. At first, the team planned to meet every day, but they soon discovered that two longer sessions each week worked better. Teachers helped with safety rules but allowed students to make most decisions. The group now publishes a short update every Friday, and next term it hopes to invite younger pupils to join selected activities.
